from pocket_coffea.processor import Processor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(Processor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor using PocketCoffea."""
    
    def process_before_preselection(self, events):
        """Hook to build custom collections before preselection."""
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[
            (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        return events

        """Hook to store object counts after preselection."""
        events["n_muon_good"] = ak.count(events.MuonGood.pt, axis=1)
        return events
